samples.xml_description:
<module id="LFSR">
    <description>A 4-bit linear feedback shift register (LFSR).</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst">Reset signal.</input>
        <output id="out" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit output representing the current state of the LFSR.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>Shifts the bits in the register and applies feedback based on the XOR of the most significant bit and the second most significant bit.</implementation>
</module>
